<thought>The compound consists of a chlorophenoxy aromatic fragment and an acetate side‑chain fragment that are connected through the phenoxy oxygen. The SMILES strings for these two connected fragments are:
1. Chlorophenoxy fragment: c1ccc(Cl)cc1O  
2. Acetate side‑chain fragment (including the methyl ester): OCC(=O)OC

These fragments can be joined at the oxygen atom to reconstruct the full molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>['c1ccc(Cl)cc1O', 'OCC(=O)OC']</final_answer>
